input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only pricing-parity language in the Agreement runs in our favour: § 6 (p0047) obliges TrueLink to hold Hosting Services costs flat for one year and to charge us rates no higher than it charges any other party. Nothing in the Compensation section, the Client covenants (§ 8) or elsewhere requires Mortgage Logic.com to extend TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers (searches for "most favored", "no less favorable", "favorable", "any other party" and "rates" return no Customer-side parity undertaking). This meets the preferred position — no MFN obligation on Customer, with a Vendor-granted MFN we retain — so no redline is proposed.
